name: badge
description: A source-owned shadcn-style status/label badge for Dioxus.

documentation.accessibility: Renders as inline content with no assigned role (`registry/ui/badge.rs`); its text is read as ordinary content by assistive technology. Use a visually-hidden prefix (e.g. "Status:") if the badge conveys state that isn't obvious from surrounding context.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; not an interactive control.
